args.query: USDA crop production corn yield by state forecast

sql: SELECT state_alpha, commodity_desc, short_desc, value, load_time FROM ag.nass_crop_estimates_current WHERE statisticcat_desc='YIELD' AND commodity_desc IN ('CORN','SOYBEANS') AND domain_desc='TOTAL' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' AND unit_desc IN ('BU / ACRE') AND state_alpha IN ('US','IA','IL','NE','MN','IN','SD','KS','OH','MO','ND','WI','MI','AR','MS') AND short_desc NOT LIKE '%SILAGE%' ORDER BY commodity_desc, state_alpha

SELECT state_alpha, commodity_desc, statisticcat_desc, unit_desc, value FROM ag.nass_crop_estimates_current WHERE statisticcat_desc IN ('PRODUCTION','AREA HARVESTED') AND commodity_desc IN ('CORN','SOYBEANS') AND domain_desc='TOTAL' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' AND unit_desc IN ('BU','ACRES') AND state_alpha IN ('US','IA','IL','MN','NE') AND short_desc NOT LIKE '%SILAGE%' ORDER BY commodity_desc, state_alpha, statisticcat_desc

SELECT "year", state_alpha, commodity_desc, statisticcat_desc, unit_desc, value FROM ag.nass_crop_production WHERE "year"=2025 AND agg_level_desc IN ('STATE','NATIONAL') AND commodity_desc IN ('CORN','SOYBEANS') AND domain_desc='TOTAL' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' AND unit_desc IN ('BU','ACRES','BU / ACRE') AND statisticcat_desc IN ('YIELD','PRODUCTION','AREA HARVESTED') AND short_desc NOT LIKE '%SILAGE%' AND state_alpha IN ('US','IA','IL','MN','NE','IN','SD','KS','OH','MO','ND','WI','MI','AR','MS') ORDER BY commodity_desc, state_alpha, statisticcat_desc

SELECT state_alpha, MAX(CASE WHEN statisticcat_desc='YIELD' THEN value END) AS yld, MAX(CASE WHEN statisticcat_desc='PRODUCTION' AND unit_desc='BU' THEN value END) AS prod, MAX(CASE WHEN statisticcat_desc='AREA HARVESTED' THEN value END) AS ha FROM ag.nass_crop_estimates_current WHERE commodity_desc='CORN' AND domain_desc='TOTAL' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' AND short_desc LIKE 'CORN, GRAIN%' AND unit_desc IN ('BU / ACRE','BU','ACRES') AND statisticcat_desc IN ('YIELD','PRODUCTION','AREA HARVESTED') AND agg_level_desc IN ('STATE','NATIONAL') GROUP BY state_alpha ORDER BY prod DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT state_alpha, MAX(CASE WHEN statisticcat_desc='YIELD' THEN value END) AS yld, MAX(CASE WHEN statisticcat_desc='PRODUCTION' AND unit_desc='BU' THEN value END) AS prod FROM ag.nass_crop_estimates_current WHERE commodity_desc='SOYBEANS' AND domain_desc='TOTAL' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' AND unit_desc IN ('BU / ACRE','BU') AND statisticcat_desc IN ('YIELD','PRODUCTION') AND agg_level_desc IN ('STATE','NATIONAL') GROUP BY state_alpha ORDER BY prod DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT state_alpha, "year", value FROM ag.nass_crop_production WHERE statisticcat_desc='YIELD' AND unit_desc='BU / ACRE' AND domain_desc='TOTAL' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' AND agg_level_desc='STATE' AND state_alpha IN ('MN','IA') AND (commodity_desc='CORN' AND short_desc LIKE 'CORN, GRAIN%' OR commodity_desc='SOYBEANS') AND "year">=2015 ORDER BY commodity_desc, state_alpha, "year"

WITH h AS (SELECT state_alpha, MAX(value) AS mx FROM ag.nass_crop_production WHERE commodity_desc='CORN' AND short_desc LIKE 'CORN, GRAIN - YIELD%' AND unit_desc='BU / ACRE' AND agg_level_desc IN ('STATE','NATIONAL') AND domain_desc='TOTAL' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' GROUP BY state_alpha) SELECT c.state_alpha, c.value AS y2026, h.mx AS max_1993_2025 FROM ag.nass_crop_estimates_current c JOIN h ON h.state_alpha=c.state_alpha WHERE c.commodity_desc='CORN' AND c.short_desc LIKE 'CORN, GRAIN - YIELD%' AND c.unit_desc='BU / ACRE' AND c.domain_desc='TOTAL' AND c.class_desc='ALL CLASSES' AND c.prodn_practice_desc='ALL PRODUCTION PRACTICES' AND c.value > h.mx ORDER BY c.state_alpha

SELECT commodity_desc, short_desc, week_ending, value FROM ag.nass_crop_progress WHERE state_alpha='US' AND commodity_desc IN ('CORN','SOYBEANS') AND "year"=2026 AND week_ending >= '2026-10-12' AND (short_desc LIKE '%MATURE%' OR short_desc LIKE '%HARVESTED%' OR short_desc LIKE '%GOOD%' OR short_desc LIKE '%EXCELLENT%') ORDER BY commodity_desc, short_desc, week_ending

SELECT commodity_desc, "year", week_ending, value FROM ag.nass_crop_progress WHERE state_alpha='US' AND commodity_desc IN ('CORN','SOYBEANS') AND "year" BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 AND (short_desc LIKE '%PCT HARVESTED') AND short_desc NOT LIKE '%SILAGE%' AND week_ending >= CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)||'-10-29' AND week_ending <= CAST("year" AS VARCHAR)||'-11-04' ORDER BY commodity_desc, "year"

SELECT commodity_desc, week_ending, value FROM ag.nass_crop_progress WHERE state_alpha='US' AND commodity_desc IN ('CORN','SOYBEANS') AND "year"=2025 AND short_desc LIKE '%PCT HARVESTED' AND short_desc NOT LIKE '%SILAGE%' AND week_ending BETWEEN '2025-10-26' AND '2025-11-09' ORDER BY 1,2
